sql: SELECT 'versions' k, count(*)::text v FROM experiment_versions UNION ALL SELECT 'epochs', count(*)::text FROM experiment_epochs UNION ALL SELECT 'mmsell_type_tight_versions', count(*)::text FROM experiment_versions v JOIN experiments e ON e.id=v.experiment_id WHERE e.key='mmsell-type-tight' UNION ALL SELECT 'open_epochs_for_that_exp', count(*)::text FROM experiment_epochs ep JOIN experiment_versions v ON v.id=ep.version_id JOIN experiments e ON e.id=v.experiment_id WHERE e.key='mmsell-type-tight' AND ep.ended_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'platform_snapshots', count(*)::text FROM platform_snapshots UNION ALL SELECT 'integrity_events', count(*)::text FROM experiment_integrity_events UNION ALL SELECT 'forced_activations', count(*)::text FROM platform_impact_actions WHERE revision_id=11 AND status='exempt'
